# Code of Conduct / 行为准则

## Our pledge / 我们的承诺

We as members, contributors, and maintainers pledge to make participation in this
project a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of background or identity.

我们承诺:无论背景与身份如何,任何人参与本项目都将免受骚扰,获得尊重与友好的对待。

## Our standards / 行为标准

Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment / 有助于积极氛围的行为:

- Using welcoming and inclusive language / 使用友好、包容的语言
- Being respectful of differing viewpoints and experience / 尊重不同的观点与经验
- Gracefully accepting constructive criticism / 大方接受建设性批评

Examples of unacceptable behavior / 不可接受的行为:

- Trolling, insulting or derogatory comments, and personal or political attacks / 人身攻击与嘲讽
- Publishing others' private information without consent / 未经同意公开他人隐私信息

## Enforcement / 执行

Instances of abusive behavior may be reported to the repository owner (via GitHub or
email 1550400341@qq.com). All complaints will be reviewed and may result in a temporary
or permanent ban from the community.

如遇不当行为,可通过 GitHub 或邮件向仓库所有者举报。所有举报都会被审视,情节严重者
可能被暂时或永久移出社区。

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org),
version 2.1, available at
https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/.
